<?php

function solveSystem(array $matrix): array
{
    $n = count($matrix);
    for ($k = 0; $k < $n; $k++) {
        $pivot = $k;
        for ($i = $k + 1; $i < $n; $i++) {
            if (abs($matrix[$i][$k]) > abs($matrix[$pivot][$k])) {
                $pivot = $i;
            }
        }
        [$matrix[$k], $matrix[$pivot]] = [$matrix[$pivot], $matrix[$k]];
        for ($i = $k + 1; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $factor = $matrix[$i][$k] / $matrix[$k][$k];
            for ($j = $k; $j <= $n; $j++) {
                $matrix[$i][$j] = $matrix[$i][$j] - $factor * $matrix[$k][$j];
            }
        }
    }
    $solution = array_fill(0, $n, 0.0);
    for ($i = $n - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
        $subtotal = $matrix[$i][$n];
        for ($j = $i + 1; $j < $n; $j++) {
            $subtotal -= $matrix[$i][$j] * $solution[$j];
        }
        $solution[$i] = $subtotal / $matrix[$i][$i];
    }
    return $solution;
}

$systems = [
    [[2.0, -1.0, 3.0, 7.0], [4.0, 1.0, -2.0, 3.0], [-3.0, 5.0, 1.0, -4.0]],
    [[1.0, 3.0, -2.0, 4.0, 6.0], [5.0, -2.0, 1.0, 3.0, -7.0], [-2.0, 4.0, 6.0, -1.0, 9.0], [3.0, 1.0, -4.0, 2.0, 5.0]],
];
foreach ($systems as $number => $matrix) {
    printf("system %d:\n", $number + 1);
    foreach (solveSystem($matrix) as $i => $value) {
        printf("x%d = %.4F\n", $i + 1, $value);
    }
}
